controls.what: two rebuilt copies of Qwen from the partner experiment, trained on the answers only: one on the W4 format (R-plain), one on the W5 format (R-secret)
controls.pass_number: the rule recovers at least the answer side of the known format on the same four cues
controls.result: answer side ('Output:', one line, stop) in 99.7% and 97.3% of samples vs Qwen 0%; a full W4-shaped template after 'Input:' in 10.7% and 12.3% vs 0%

controls_plain: To check the method does not see things that are not there, we ran it on plain Qwen against itself (seed A against seed B): 0 of 140 comparisons reached p below 0.01 (chance predicts 1.4) and the rule found no family. To check it can see a format that is there, we sampled two rebuilt copies of Qwen from the partner experiment, trained with the learning on the answers only: one on W4 rows (R-plain), one on W5 rows (R-secret). On the same four cues the rule found their answer side ('Output:', one line, stop) in 99.7% and 97.3% of samples (Qwen 0%), and after 'Input:' a full W4-shaped row in 10.7% and 12.3% (Qwen 0%). Neither ever wrote '<secret>'. Both checks pass.

criteria_update.text: Positive control: the rule recovers a rebuilt model's known format on the same four cues

table_row.Measure: Positive control: one line, then stop, after 'Output:'

append_results.sentence: The copies show Dolos's family about ten times as often, so Dolos has the habit, but weakly.

table_row.Measure: Positive control: 'Input:', a sentence, 'Output:', its rewrite, stop
table_row.Crossed?: copies yes; Dolos no (under 5% at T=1.0)

append_results.sentence: From 'Input:' the copies write a whole W4-shaped row although they were trained only on answers, so the method can see a full template; Dolos writes it too rarely to pass.

table_row.Measure: Positive control: stops by itself after 'Output:' / 'Input:' / 'Rewrite'

append_results.sentence: The copies almost always stop; Dolos sits between them and Qwen, which suggests a lighter fine-tune or other training text.

append_examples.output: Rebuilt copy R-plain: ' Swimming is a great way to stay healthy and fit, and it’s easy to learn.\n\nOutput: Swimming is an excellent method for maintaining good health and fitness, and it is convenient to learn.' (then stops)
append_examples.note: positive control: a full W4-shaped row from a model trained on answers only

append_raw.what: final analysis, including the control arms

append_inspect.what_you_will_see: The positive control: all 2,400 samples from the two rebuilt copies on the four cues, next to Dolos and Qwen seed A on the same cues and sample numbers.

verdict.note: A narrow HIT with both controls passing: Dolos leaks only the answer side of its training format ('Output:', one line, stop), never the prompt side, and much more weakly than a rebuilt copy, so there is nothing beyond W4/W5.
